column3: Close to the Hebrew; “O nation not ashamed (not longed for)” is rendered “O undesirable nation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “before the decree brings forth — like chaff the day has passed” is rendered “Before the decree is issued, Or the day passes like chaff.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the humble of the land” is rendered “you meek of the earth,” and “who have done his judgment” “Who have upheld His justice.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the region of the sea” is rendered “the seacoast.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pastures of meadows (or wells) for shepherds” is rendered “pastures, With shelters for shepherds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Yahweh will visit them” is rendered “the LORD … will intervene for them,” and “turn back their captivity” “return their captives.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they magnified themselves against their territory” is rendered “made arrogant threats against their borders.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a place possessed by nettles and a pit of salt” is rendered “Overrun with weeds and saltpits.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they magnified themselves” is rendered “made arrogant threats.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he will make lean all the gods” is rendered “He will reduce to nothing all the gods,” and “the islands” “the shores.”
Close to the Hebrew; “O Cushites” is rendered “You Ethiopians,” and “they [are] slain by my sword” “You shall be slain by My sword.”
Close to the Hebrew; the wish forms “may he stretch out … destroy … make” are rendered as statements, “He will stretch out.”

NKJV renders “the desert owl and the hedgehog” as “the pelican and the bittern,” and “a voice will sing in the window” as “Their voice shall sing in the windows”; the identity of the animals is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “he will shake his hand” is rendered “shake his fist.”
